# Legal Risk and Regulatory Control Review for Strategy 2026

This document outlines key objectives for the Risk & Compliance department concerning Strategy 2026.

*   We need to review the legal risks for strategy 2026.
*   We need to optimize the regulatory changes quarterly.
*   We need to update the internal control based on audit.
*   We need to update the internal control for strategy 2026.
*   We need to monitor the internal control for strategy 2026.
